note:
At least 80% of cells should have either a cot, a bench. Needs many more objects and much more object diversity. Almost no cell should have 0 objects in it. Bones, barrels of tools, a piece of meat, a cot, etc
Jails in towns should always have a large entry /guard room with a desk and some decor
Entry/guard rooms need to be significantly bigger so they don't feel too crowded. 
Cells are a great location for holes that the player can fall through. (secret escape through a tunnel)
